material.arcana.crystalsong.encyclopedia: Moss crystal packed until it rings like rock. Tools made from it carry Deepwell: worn or held, they lift your Ars Nouveau mana ceiling by 10% per level.
material.arcana.quicksteel.encyclopedia: Light steel quenched in essence. Tools made from it carry Swiftcast: worn or held, they cut the cooldown after each Ars Nouveau cast by 8% per level.
material.arcana.starstone.encyclopedia: A starbuncle's token, pried out of the bedrock and pressed into stone. Tools made from it carry Manawell: wear it and the mana bar climbs on its own, 10 mana per second per level.
modifier.arcana.manaflow.description: Worn or held, restores 5 extra Ars Nouveau mana per second per level.
modifier.arcana.deepwell.description: Worn or held, raises your maximum Ars Nouveau mana by 10% per level.
modifier.arcana.swiftcast.flavor: The word lands before the thought finishes.
modifier.arcana.swiftcast.description: Shortens the cooldown after each Ars Nouveau cast by 8% per level.
modifier.arcana.manawell.flavor: Put it on, and the mana comes back.
modifier.arcana.manawell.description: Worn or held, restores 10 extra Ars Nouveau mana per second per level.
